frase_gancho.texto: Jungles, rivers and rubber: the coast where the first great culture was born.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You leave the valleys of Oaxaca behind and descend into the heat and humidity of the Gulf Coast. Here, more than three thousand years ago, the first great culture of Mesoamerica arose: the Olmec, the people of rubber, with their colossal heads and their jades. Later came the cities of Veracruz, passionate about the ballgame, with their smiling little faces and their clay goddesses, and to the north the Huastec, sculptors of fertility. In this hall, jade, rubber, clay and stone live side by side, along with three thousand years of a rainy, fertile and generous region. We begin with a face that has been gazing back at us for more than three thousand years.
